title: Soft tennis team hopes breakthrough bronze fuels other Pinoy athletes
summary: Bien Zoleta is urging her fellow Filipino athletes to make the most of their Asian Games moment after the Philippine women's soft tennis team ended the country's medal drought in the sport.
